title: Toast vs Square for Restaurants (2026): Fees & Fit | Chowly

facts.fact: Toast's Starter Kit entry plan costs $0 per month, according to Toast's published pricing as of June 2026.
facts.quote: the Starter Kit plan is $0/month, the Point of Sale plan is $69/month

facts.fact: Toast's Point of Sale plan costs $69 per month, according to Toast's published pricing as of June 2026.
facts.quote: the Point of Sale plan is $69/month

facts.fact: Toast's New Restaurant Basics bundle, a POS-plus-payroll package for new operators, starts at $110 per month.
facts.quote: New Restaurant Basics — a POS-plus-payroll bundle aimed at new operators — starts at $110/month.

facts.fact: Toast's standard in-person card processing rate is 2.49% plus 15 cents per transaction.
Toast's pay-as-you-go option has $0 upfront hardware costs in exchange for a 2.99% plus 15 cents processing rate and a 2-year agreement, offered to new single-location customers.
facts.quote: hardware costs covered at $0 upfront in exchange for a higher 2.99% + 15¢ processing rate and a 2-year agreement

facts.fact: Square's Free plan costs $0 per month, according to Square's published pricing as of June 2026.
Square's Plus plan costs $49 per month per location, according to Square's published pricing as of June 2026.
Square's Premium plan costs $149 per month per location, according to Square's published pricing as of June 2026.
Square's Pro plan is custom-priced for operations processing over $250K per year.
facts.quote: Pro is custom-priced for operations processing over $250K per year.

facts.fact: Square's in-person processing rate is 2.6% plus 15 cents on the Free plan, 2.5% plus 15 cents on Plus, and 2.4% plus 15 cents on Premium.
facts.quote: 2.6% + 15¢ on Free, 2.5% + 15¢ on Plus, 2.4% + 15¢ on Premium
plug a $59 Reader into your phone

facts.fact: Square's hardware ranges from the $59 Reader to the $899 Register, with the Stand at $149, Terminal at $299, and Handheld at $399 in between.
facts.quote: Hardware runs from the $59 Reader through the $149 Stand, $299 Terminal, and $399 Handheld up to the $899 Register.

facts.fact: Square's kitchen display system is priced at $30 per month per device on Plus and $20 per month per device on Premium.
facts.quote: $30/month per device on Plus, $20/month on Premium

facts.fact: Square's kiosk add-on costs $50 or $30 per device per month.
facts.quote: kiosk is likewise $50 or $30 per device monthly

facts.fact: Square's ingredient-level inventory via the MarketMan integration costs $99 per month per location.
facts.quote: requires the MarketMan integration at $99/month per location

facts.fact: Square's Plus and Premium plans each include a 30-day free trial.
facts.quote: Plus and Premium even carry a 30-day free trial.

facts.fact: Square states there is no long-term contract on any plan.
facts.quote: there is no long-term contract on any plan

facts.fact: The article states that every number in it comes from each company's official pricing pages as of June 2026.
facts.quote: Every number in this article comes from each company's official pricing pages as of June 2026.
